name: openspec-apply-change
title_zh: 从 OpenSpec 变更单直接开工，任务拆到能动手
tagline_zh: 别再对着 PRD 发呆。把变更描述变成一步步可执行的任务清单，每步都有验收标准，照着做就能提交代码。
tagline_en: Stop staring at a vague spec. Turn an OpenSpec change into a task list with checkable steps, ready to code and.
desc_en: Implement tasks from an OpenSpec change. Use when the user wants to start implementing, continue implementation, or work through tasks.
why_zh: 它不替你写代码，而是把变更拆成可验证的增量，让实现过程可追踪、可回退，避免大改翻车。
why_en: It doesn't write code for you—it breaks a change into verifiable increments, keeping implementation traceable and rollback-safe.
limit_zh: 只认 OpenSpec 格式的变更描述（含 tasks 目录）。若你的需求是自由文本或 issue。
limit_en: Only works with OpenSpec changes (tasks/ folder). Free-text or issue-based specs must be converted first. Output is a task list, not code.
title_en: Turn an OpenSpec change into actionable tasks
